response.question: Which saved hotel is cheapest for two nights from October 11 to October 13, 2026?
response.proposed_sql: SELECT h.hotel_id, COALESCE(h.name, '(name not provided)') AS name, SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents) AS total_cost_cents FROM saved_hotels h JOIN demo_hotel_nights n ON h.hotel_id = n.hotel_id WHERE n.stay_date >= '2026-10-11' AND n.stay_date < '2026-10-13' GROUP BY h.hotel_id, h.name HAVING COUNT(n.stay_date) = 2 AND MIN(n.rooms_available) >= 1 ORDER BY total_cost_cents ASC LIMIT 50
response.reason: Finds all saved hotels available for the two-night stay from October 11 to October 13, 2026, and orders them by total cost.
response.answer:
I recommend the Nittany Lion Inn. It is the cheapest option for your two-night stay from October 11 to October 13, 2026, with a total cost of $200.00.
